prompt_text: Who is the best property management company in St. Louis MO for a rental home?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one universally “best” company—it depends on the home’s location, condition, and how hands-on you want to be. **For a single-family rental, I’d start by comparing Avenue Residential Leasing & Management and HomeSTRETCH Property Management.** Avenue describes a full-service offering with leasing, rent collection, and emergency maintenance; HomeSTRETCH also lists leasing, screening, maintenance coordination, inspections, and financial reporting.

A few other options to check:

- **STL Smart Rentals** — appears focused on single-family rentals in the county.
- **Evernest** — lists single-family homes among its specialties and publishes fee information, though confirm the current terms directly.
- **RENOSY by Renters Warehouse** — advertises a flat-rate plan and a broad set of management services.

Before choosing, get written quotes from at least three firms and compare the **total** cost—not just the monthly management percentage. Ask about leasing and renewal fees, maintenance markups, inspection frequency, eviction-related charges, cancellation terms, and who approves repairs. Also check recent **owner** references, since public review scores may reflect tenants’ experiences more than owners’.

Sources: [Avenue Residential](https://propertymanagementstl.com/), [HomeSTRETCH](https://homestretchpropertymanagement.com/), [Evernest](https://www.stlouispropertymanagement.co/blog/best-property-management-companies-in-st-louis), [RENOSY by Renters Warehouse](https://www.renterswarehouse.com/offices/st-louis).
